Do you want to be part of an international company where precision, compliance, and employee service go hand in hand? For our People, Branding & Sustainability team, we are looking for a Lead - Payroll & Compliance for our location at KK Group in Hammel.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 05/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Hammel, Hammel

Purpose of Role

In this role, you will be an important, trusted partner for employees, managers, and external stakeholders, ensuring accurate payroll administration, high-quality payroll processes, and compliance with labor legislation and internal policies. You will play a key role in managing working time, absences, reporting, and coordination with external payroll vendors, while also contributing to the development and optimization of processes and systems.

If you thrive in a role with responsibility, structure, and close collaboration across the organization, this could be the next step in your career.

Responsibilities

• Ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of input data for payroll processing, including absence, working hours, and other payroll-related information

• Working closely with external payroll providers and supporting effective coordination of payroll activities

• Handling People-related tasks within your area of responsibility

• Providing professional support and guidance to employees and managers on payroll and compliance matters

• Handling absence-related tasks and communicating relevant information to employees and managers

• Administering payroll and employee benefit matters related to employee absence

• Supporting tax and insurance settlements in collaboration with external providers

• Preparing reports, payroll data, and analysis

• Advising business leaders on employment law and payroll-related matters within your area of expertise

• Providing guidance in connection with the preparation of contracts, addendums etc.

• Supporting internal and external audits

• Contributing to the implementation of new systems

• Supporting the implementation of new employee benefits in payroll processes

• Participating in projects related to payroll, compliance, and the continued development of the function

• Identifying opportunities to improve payroll processes, data quality, and employee service

Our requirements

• You have several years of experience in a similar role within payroll, compliance, or HR administration

• You can communicate fluently in Danish and English

• You have experience working with payroll in a manufacturing environment and understand the specific requirements associated with this type of organization

• You have solid knowledge of Danish employment law and social security regulations

• You have hands-on experience with time registration, absence management, and payroll processes

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on accuracy and quality

• You are service-minded and motivated by supporting employees and managers

• You have strong communication and collaboration skills and are comfortable working with stakeholders across the organization

• You are confident working with payroll data, reporting, and analyses

• You have strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel.

• You have a relevant educational background in employment law, economics, finance, payroll, or a related field

• Experience with D365, including the Time & Attendance and HR modules, will be considered an advantage.

• You have valid driver’s license

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Nicolai Bach Bundgaard +45 5084 7059

Camilla Sjølund Sørensen

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

jobs.description:
As a Sr. Enterprise Account Executive for the Nordic markets, you will lead Performativ’s commercial expansion in the region. You will build the Enterprise market by developing pipeline, engaging key institutions, and closing complex enterprise deals with the largest asset managers, banks, and wealth managers.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Own and build the Nordic Enterprise market from day one.

• 
Generate pipeline through outbound activity, industry networking, and direct engagement with leading financial institutions.

• 
Own the full enterprise sales cycle from first meeting through closing seven figure platform deals.

• 
Apply a MEDDPICC driven sales approach to manage complex enterprise opportunities.

• 
Develop relationships with senior stakeholders across operations, technology, and executive leadership.

• 
Represent Performativ at industry events, conferences, and within the Nordic wealth and asset management ecosystem.

• 
Work closely with leadership, product, and marketing to refine positioning and messaging for the Nordic market.

• 
Contribute to demand generation efforts through partnerships, events, and targeted market outreach.

• 
Build strategic account plans targeting leading asset managers, private banks, and wealth managers.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
7 to 10 years of enterprise sales experience within fintech, investment technology, or capital markets infrastructure.

• 
Proven track record closing seven figure software or platform deals with large financial institutions.

• 
Strong understanding of how financial institutions operate across operations, portfolio management, and technology.

• 
Knowledge of the Nordic regulatory landscape within wealth management and capital markets.

• 
Experience using MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology.

• 
Ability to navigate long and complex enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• 
Strong network within the Nordic wealth management, asset management, or private banking ecosystem.

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort building a new market with high autonomy.

• 
Experience contributing to pipeline generation and market development initiatives.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• 
Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Our mission is to help replatform the financial services industry by providing modern infrastructure that enables institutions to scale faster and operate more efficiently.

Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations and cannot wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

We value passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

💰 🇩🇰 up to 64,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

****_Join our SAP Team in Copenhagen:

_****Be the Dual-Hatted Subject Matter Expert for Commercial & ERP Excellence.

**Are you a skilled SAP professional who thrives at the intersection of modern cloud frontends and core backend logic? We are looking for an SAP Subject Matter Expert to join our SAP team in Ørestaden.

In this role, you will be the ultimate functional authority. We need a front runner who can bridge our cutting-edge customer experience strategies and ERP backend architecture. Joining our SAP Application Management (AMS) department, you will be the core anchor driving strategic projects, and ensuring our end-to-end commercial landscape runs at full throttle.

**What The Job Is…

**In this unique position, you will split your expertise across two core pillars: acting as the primary internal owner for our CRM platform (SAP Sales & Service Cloud / C4C) and serving as an active functional expert within our SAP AMS team for SAP SD (Sales & Distribution).

• The CRM Pillar: You will maintain, configure, and develop our CRM system to optimize our customer lifecycle. For heavier technical tasks and deep development, you will have the backing of our external implementation & support partners.

• The SAP SD Pillar: You will be an active member of our SAP AMS team, managing projects within the SD area and configuring changes. Your primary mission here is to safeguard our core backend systems so that daily order intake remains completely undisturbed.

• The Digital Bridge: Simultaneously, you will be working in close alignment with our digital team to support our B2B Satair Market portal when it comes to backend synchronisation.

**Your Main Responsibilities Include

**CRM Management (SAP CX Sales & Service Cloud)

• Overseeing the day-to-day maintenance, configuration, and functional evolution of SAP Sales Cloud and Service Cloud to deliver enhancements and support.

• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting front-end business requirements and mapping them cleanly to standard SAP CRM functionalities.

• Configuring sales processes (including lead/opportunity lifecycle, pipeline management, quotations, activities).

• Configuring service processes (including Supplier discrepancies and Customer Claims handling, escalation paths, and omnichannel integration).

• Steering our external partner on advanced customizations, acting as their primary internal counterpart for heavy development deliverables.

• Staying current on the SAP roadmap and best practices to act as a trusted advisor, ensuring solutions align with our customer experience (CX) goals.

SAP SD Architecture & AMS Project Management

• Designing, customizing, and implementing functional SAP SD process solutions, including the preparation of blueprints, configuration rules, and technical documentation.

• Managing functional projects and enhancement tracks within the SD space, including taking direct project management ownership and supporting wider ARD application maps.

• Building and maintaining backend changes with a strong focus on risk mitigation to guarantee our business-critical order intake processes run smoothly.

• Partnering tightly with the internal Digital department to align configuration flows and secure flawless data exchange for the Satair Market portal.

• Executing functional unit testing and system validation for newly built configurations prior to standard release cycles, and supporting business users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

**Who You Are

**This role is defined by your mindset and professional discipline. We are looking for a teammate who is:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical/commercial field.

• Professional Foundation: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on functional experience across SAP ecosystems, featuring a clear operational split between CRM platforms and core ERP logistics.

• CRM Expertise: 3+ years of direct experience configuring SAP Sales & Service Cloud (C4C), including system lifecycles, account management, ticket handling, and standard migration toolkits (Data Workbench).

• SAP SD Expertise: Proven functional and technical proficiency executing end-to-end configurations, process design, and blueprinting inside the SAP SD module (Pricing, Billing, Order Processing, Partner Determination). S/4HANA transformation experience is a strong asset.

• Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to independently drive smaller to mid-sized IT projects or specific operational phases from blueprinting through test validation to go-live.

• Languages: Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills in English.

**Key Competencies

**

• Analytical Problem-Solving: A process-oriented mindset capable of isolating data synchronization anomalies and securing business continuity.

• Consultative Approach: Strong communication skills with the confidence to challenge business requirements, lead workshops, and align needs with best-practice SAP standard processes.

• Autonomy & Teamwork: A self-motivated individual who thrives when working independently within the AMS team while maintaining tight, proactive alignments with cross-functional digital teams.

• Adaptability: The agility to pivot effortlessly between front-end customer experience (CX) strategies and detailed backend technical configuration logic.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our Development Denmark team in a role focused on validating and qualifying grid measurement systems used in wind park control applications. Your day may start in the laboratory testing Elspec G4K/G4N grid meters, evaluating measurement accuracy and communication performance under different operating conditions. You will work hands-on with measurement hardware, analyze complex datasets, and develop automated test solutions using Python and MATLAB.

Working closely with engineering, cybersecurity, SCADA, and supplier teams, you will help ensure that grid measurement systems meet performance, reliability, and security requirements. Your work will directly contribute to supplier evaluations and the successful integration of measurement technologies within wind power plant control solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Validate and evaluate grid measurement devices used in wind park control systems, with a primary focus on Elspec G4K/G4N meters, supporting supplier qualification and technology assessments.

• 
Design, execute, and automate test campaigns using Python and/or MATLAB, including integration with Omicron signal generators, measurement equipment, data acquisition systems, and structured CI/CD testing frameworks.

• 
Troubleshoot measurement hardware, communication interfaces, and laboratory test setups to identify, analyze, and resolve performance issues.

• 
Analyze measurement data from devices, SCADA systems, and SQL databases, transforming results into clear technical insights, reports, visualizations, and recommendations that support engineering decisions.

• 
Verify secure communication and cybersecurity requirements, including protocols such as Modbus/TLS and Syslog/TLS, certificate-based authentication, secure onboarding, logging and telemetry capabilities, and compliance with IEC 62443 and emerging Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) requirements.

What You Bring

• 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• 
Experience working with electrical measurement systems, power systems, data acquisition equipment, or similar industrial technologies, including structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

• 
Proficiency in Python application development for test automation, data analysis, and software development, with a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

• 
Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C# and/or C++.

• 
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• 
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development Denmark team, where engineers collaborate to validate grid measurement systems used in wind park control and power plant environments. The team combines hands-on laboratory testing with advanced data analysis to assess performance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support supplier evaluations.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• 
Opportunities to work with a global team

• 
Medical benefits

• 
Remote/Flexible work

• 
Paid holidays and parental leave

• 
Employer-funded pension

• 
Subsidised lunch and more

Are you passionate about electronics, test automation, and developing reliable production test solutions?

Weibel is experiencing significant growth, and we are looking for a NPI Development & Test Engineer to join our Production Engineering team in Allerød.

At Weibel, we develop and manufacture some of the world's most advanced radar systems. Our low-volume, high-complexity manufacturing environment gives you a unique opportunity to influence products throughout their lifecycle, from early development to stable production.

As part of our Production Engineering & QA team, you will play a key role in ensuring our products can be tested efficiently and manufactured to the highest quality standards.

Technical anchor and world class expertise

In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with process optimization. You will work on everything from developing automated test solutions and solving production challenges to supporting new product introductions and collaborating with suppliers. Your expertise will contribute directly to product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and the successful scaling of innovative technologies into production

Your primary responsibilities include:

• Develop, maintain, and optimize production test solutions for electronic assemblies and modules.

• Design and implement automated test equipment, software, and processes.

• Contribute to Design for Test (DFT) and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) activities.

• Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transfer of new products into production.

• Troubleshoot test equipment and manufacturing issues in collaboration with Production and R&D.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to improve quality and production stability.

• Provide technical support to Procurement and Production, including supplier collaboration, technical evaluations, and issue resolution.

• Create and maintain test specifications, work instructions, and technical reports.

• Drive continuous improvements in manufacturing processes, test coverage, and production efficiency.

Your Profile

We expect that you have an engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

In addition, you can recognize yourself in several of the following:

• Have experience developing automated test systems and production test solutions.

• Have experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, or similar technologies.

• Possess strong troubleshooting and debugging skills within electronics and test environments.

• Have a solid understanding of electronics, instrumentation, and hardware/software integration.

• Are familiar with manufacturing processes, DFT, DFM, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Enjoy collaborating across engineering, production, quality, and supply chain functions.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Your new team

When you join Weibel, you become part of a strong Production organization of 200 skilled colleagues working across purchasing, planning, warehouse operations, electronics and mechanical production, and radar assembly.

You will join a skilled Production Engineering team that work on close collaboration with R&D, Production and Quality. We value technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and collaboration. Our team has a direct impact on product quality, manufacturability, and the successful introduction of new technologies into production.

At Weibel, we believe that great technology is created by talented people working together. We offer a challenging and rewarding environment where you can develop your technical skills while contributing to products at the forefront of radar technology.

Application and contact

Please apply via our website using the “Apply” button.

If you have any questions, please contact our Head of Production Engineering & QA, Tonny Kaempe.

The application deadline is 25th of October 2026.

Please note that the position requires a clean criminal record.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

Do you have experience leading system design and development of complex systems?

Weibel is recognized as a world leader in radar technology, with our radars performing with a precision largely unmatched by competitors. Applications for our radars include Space Research, Missile Defence, Instrumentation Systems and lately for Drone and UAS Detection and Defence. Our radars are developed and produced in-house which allows us to explore new solutions without compromising quality.

Increasing customer demand means that the company is experiencing rapid growth. As part of this growth, we are looking for a new colleague for our Systems Engineering team.

About the position

As our new colleague you will be responsible for system architecture including system documentation and associated requirements engineering. As the design authority on the system level, you will work in close cooperation with our subsystem architects, ensuring that the various subsystems work together in a manner that will satisfy the overall system requirements.

jobs.occupation: Professor of Geological Mapping and Mineral Resources
jobs.description:
The Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS) seeks excellent candidates with a strong research profile in one or more disciplines related to igneous and sedimentary rock geology, geologically applied geophysics and geochemistry, ore geology, remote sensing, tectonics and structural evolution to fill a new full professor position. The professorship focuses on Greenland and the surrounding Arctic.

  You are expected to contribute to GEUS’ overall strategy by strengthening and further developing our knowledge of the geological evolution of Greenland from a combined field geology, laboratory analysis and modelling approach. An important element is advancing the understanding of the various geological settings in Greenland with a broad scientific focus spanning from paleogeography, sedimentary basins, mountain belts and rift zones to tectonic features and associated mineral systems.

  Furthermore, you are expected to promote our ideas, expertise and concepts to the surrounding societies, to deliver research output at a high international level, and to successfully obtain funding for and lead larger research projects. Moreover, the position aims to strengthen and profile our research, public sector consultancy and advisory activities.

  The position is in the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, which is located at GEUS’ main office in Copenhagen.

  About the position
 The candidate is expected to establish and further develop a strong and coherent research group in the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, which will closely cooperate with the other departments in GEUS as well as with Danish universities and relevant international research institutions. Many of GEUS’ activities in this research field are focused on the geology of Greenland and the surrounding Arctic, and fieldwork in Greenland will be a key activity. Moreover, development and application of new, innovative methods for efficient data analysis are expected to continuously contribute to the advancement of the research field, and the professor is expected to play a central role in this context.

  Candidates for professorships at GEUS must have a strong research profile in the field and have a strong publication track record in international research journals with high impact in the research field. Moreover, candidates are expected to have played and have the ambition to play a key role in advancing the research field, for example by taking part in the organisation of international conferences and by editing relevant journals and/or book series.

  Research activities are to a large extent dependent on external funding. GEUS has a strong tradition for attracting research funding from e.g. Danish research councils, the European Commission, private foundations and authorities. GEUS also leads and acts as a partner in internationally funded research projects such as EU Horizon projects. Professors at GEUS should have a strong track record of research funding and play a leading role in research funding applications and project management.

  Professors at GEUS are expected to set the direction for GEUS’ research within their field of expertise and related fields to develop and advance research and make new ideas thrive in an open and welcoming research environment. Furthermore, professors at GEUS play an active role in career planning for early-career scientific staff and take responsibility for the supervision of PhD students and postdoctoral researchers. They are also expected to have a collaborative spirit and actively engage with other professors, project managers and staff to contribute to a dynamic research environment. Moreover, professors may become members of GEUS’ research committee and act as sparring partners for management decisions on strategic planning and hiring plans for scientific staff.

  GEUS is an independent research institution under the Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities. GEUS provides research-based public sector consultancy for Danish governmental institutions and research-based advice to private companies. Professors are expected to take part in such public sector consultancy and act as sparring partners for colleagues and management in such matters.

  Who are you? 
 We seek candidates with an excellent international profile. Consideration will be given to your international network, your ability to engage and motivate staff, as well as your openness, drive and interpersonal skills.

  You have a research profile in the field, and you have visions and ideas for developing the research field. You are experienced in creating and establishing research projects with different partners, obtaining external funding, and in leading and managing large research projects.

  Experience with supervising MSc and PhD students as well as early-career researchers is a prerequisite.

  We also expect you to have experience with public sector consultancy, advisory activities (or similar), and fieldwork. Especially, experience with fieldwork in Greenland and/or another Arctic/Antarctic environment is considered advantageous.

  The Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources
 In the Department for Mapping and Mineral Resources, we conduct research on rocks, their mineralogy and chemical composition, and their genesis and evolution. We use this insight to provide the geological background for investment opportunities in exploration for mineral resources and data for responsible natural resource management. For this work, we have considerable in-house analytical facilities, including instruments for analysis of major and trace elements, isotopic composition and analytical microscopy.

  One of the department’s important tasks is the continuous geological mapping of Greenland. In addition to the above-mentioned tools, we acquire and analyse high-resolution stereographic images of mountain walls in our photo laboratory, which provides our geologists with a powerful tool for the development of 3D geological mapping on metres to tens of kilometres scales. Finally, the department hosts D-MIC (Danish Mineral Intelligence Centre), which analyses raw materials’ value chains, thereby linking geological knowledge to society’s need for mineral raw materials.
 
 A working environment with a focus on professional development and well-being

  There are many good reasons why you should choose a working life at GEUS.

  We are a diverse staff of about 300 committed employees. Trust and flexibility are keywords. The working environment is lively, informal and international. Our tasks are versatile and there are plenty of opportunities for you to influence the development of your task portfolio.

  We prioritise professional development, among other things by offering access to courses and other relevant activities. Socialising is also very important at GEUS, and we have a rich social life with a staff club, an art association and more.

  At GEUS, we prioritise the well-being of every single employee. We prioritise that the Heads of Departments are close to the employees, and we have flexible working hours that allow you to organise your life so that there is time for what matters to you. If you need to work from home occasionally, that is also possible.

  Furthermore, we have a gym with associated physiotherapists.

  Salary and conditions of employment
 The position as Professor is permanent. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the relevant trade union agreement. Supplements can be negotiated according to skills.

  The appointment area is the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities and its institutions.

  The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities considers diversity to be an asset and encourages anyone regardless of gender, age, religion or ethnicity to seek the position.

  Additional information
 If you would like additional information, please contact the Head of Department, Mikael Pedersen on telephone +45 22 21 65 75, e-mail mp@geus.dk, or Managing Director, Lars Nielsen, on telephone +45 91 33 38 70, e-mail larni@geus.dk.

  If you are an international applicant, you can read more about living and working in Denmark on GEUS’ website.

  Are you interested?
 Please write the application in English and include a letter of motivation, your PhD diploma and CV incl. your ORCID, as well as a complete list of publications with 1) a separate indication of peer-reviewed journal articles and 2) an indication of publications where you have been either the lead or senior author.

  Please include in the application the relevant academic works that you wish to be included in the professor assessment (max. 10). Please enclose other material that documents your research and teaching qualifications.

  You are requested to include a 2-3-page account that refers to your most important academic work with relevance to the position. Finally, you are encouraged to write a one-page explanation of your plans for the development of the field. In addition to the material that you would like to be included in the assessment, the assessment committee may choose to include further material in their assessment. It is your responsibility to send the material to the committee upon request.
 
 It is mandatory to include your updated ResearcherID and/or ORCID, which will be used to assess your publication record in Web of Science. Any recently accepted or submitted publications may be added separately to the list of publications.
 
 We must have your application at the latest on Monday 9 November 2026 (Danish time).

  Applications or other material received after the deadline will not be considered.

  The appointment procedure
 A professional assessment committee consisting of one internal and two to four external assessors at minimum professor level will carry out an individual assessment of all applicants’ professional qualifications, and the applicants will be assessed as qualified or unqualified for the position. Afterwards, an internal employment committee will decide which of the professionally qualified candidates will be invited for a job interview. This procedure is in accordance with the “Order on employment and assessment of scientific staff at the Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland § 4 and 7”.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Coastal Engineering (Wave-Vegetation Interaction) - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
How can coastal vegetation help protect our coastlines from waves and flooding? Understanding how waves interact with vegetation is key to exploring its potential for coastal protection and climate adaptation. Are you interested in combining fluid mechanics, mathematical analysis and numerical modelling to help answer this question.

Then join us for a 3-year PhD fellowship in coastal engineering at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Section for Fluid Mechanics, Coastal and Maritime Engineering.

Your PhD research will play an integral part in the project “Marine advection and dissipation in the vegetated coastal environment”, financed by the Independent Research Fund Denmark.

You will collaborate with researchers at DTU and DHI in Denmark, as well as at University College Dublin, Ireland and Northeastern University, USA.

Responsibilities 
Your primary tasks will be to develop analytical and numerical models for waves interacting with coastal vegetation. Particular emphasis will be placed on the wave-averaged flow generated by surface waves and on the changes introduced by vegetation canopies.

The research will include:

• Development and validation of models for wave-induced mean velocity profiles over vegetated beds under regular waves.
• Extension of these models to irregular wave fields, including derivation of wave-averaged shear-stress distributions and mean velocity profiles.
• Investigation of undertow and circulation currents above vegetated beds in the surf zone under breaking waves.
• Development of a cross-shore momentum balance describing wave-induced changes in mean water level and the potential reduction of storm-surge flooding by coastal vegetation.
• Numerical simulations using computational fluid dynamics 
• Application of advanced turbulence models for surface-wave flows, modified to account for vegetation.
• Validation of the developed models against existing high-quality laboratory datasets.
• Development of practical parameterizations suitable for implementation in larger-scale coastal and hydrodynamic models.
The project combines fundamental fluid mechanics with applications directly relevant to coastal protection and climate adaptation. A major scientific objective is to move beyond conventional empirical vegetation models and instead explicitly account for the modification of the wave-induced velocity field within and above vegetation canopies.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following areas:

• Coastal or ocean engineering
• Fluid mechanics or hydrodynamics
• Computational fluid dynamics
• Environmental hydraulics
• Applied mathematics or a closely related field
Experience with numerical modelling, programming and/or CFD is highly desirable. Experience with turbulence modelling, wave mechanics or coastal hydrodynamics would be advantageous, but is not essential. Strong mathematical skills and an interest in combining theoretical analysis with numerical modelling are important.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is anticipated as 1 February 2027, or according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Professor David R. Fuhrman (drfu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 10 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.
